German Tech Holding GmbH & Co. KGaA: Determination of the subscription price of the ongoing public subscription offer on 22 October 2026

– German Tech Holding (GTH) expects an initial external assessment of Zirnostics GmbH, of its zirconium-89-labelled PSMA tracer technology and its clinical rationale on 21 October 2026. It will determine and publish the subscription price for the ongoing public subscription offer of GTH treasury shares on 22 October 2026. The subscription period runs until 27 October 2026. Details of the subscription offer are set out in the announcements of 9 and 13 October as well as in the subscription offer published on 12 October 2026 together with further documents (https://germantechholding.com/index.php/for-shareholders/the-share/).

In the course of the ongoing public offer for the subscription of treasury shares, the proceeds of which are to fund the intended seizing of its exclusive investment opportunity in Zirnostics GmbH published on 7 October 2026, GTH has received purchase applications from shareholders, including oversubscription requests. Christoph Gerlinger, CEO and founder of GTH, the members of his family and their vehicles have also submitted their purchase applications and have exercised their subscription rights in full therein. In the event that the final subscription price is set at the lower end of the subscription price range, GG Beteiligungen UG has furthermore undertaken to acquire all shares not subscribed for by shareholders of GTH. Christoph Gerlinger holds an indirect interest of just under 50 % in GG Beteiligungen UG. Christoph Gerlinger's family's stake in GTH could thus reach up to 77 %.
German Tech Holding (GTH) is an investment company founded in 2012 and based in Frankfurt am Main.

During its active years as a leading German venture capital provider under the name German Startups Group, GTH held stakes with great success in, among others, Chrono24, Delivery Hero, Fiagon, Mister Spex, Remerge and Scalable Capital. To this day it holds investments including AuctionTech, SoundCloud and Thinksurance. Through its SaaS-based white-label solution PropNow for digital bidding and offer processes in the real estate market, AuctionTech is the European market leader.

GTH pursues opportunities in the fields of artificial intelligence and life sciences/biotech. Cognicare AI, a spin-off from GTH's investment in the company builder Softmax AI, addresses the structurally growing market for senior care facilities with highly sought-after AI applications. In the field of life science, GTH is examining an investment opportunity in Zirnostics GmbH that has presented itself and has signed a term sheet in this regard. Zirnostics is preparing a clinical trial for the approval of its disruptive tracer for PSMA-PET/CT imaging in prostate cancer, which is up to 100-fold superior to legacy tracers in terms of tumour-to-background contrast and has already been successfully clinically tested for years in several hundred patients.
